描述_EN: 1794) the second section; and yamamoto ikyu, the third. 30; wai-kam ho et al, eight dynasties of chinese painting: the collections of the nelson-atkins museum, kansas city, and the cleveland museum of art, cleveland 1980, pl. 95; craig clunas, art in china, oxford 1997, fig. 98. kin juro copied the opening; hashimoto eiki (d. described by the eminent english poet, dramatist and art historian laurence binyon as one of the finest examples of chinese painting in the former eumorfopoulos collection, this intruging picture is a reverse image, with minor compositional differences, of the last section of the "nine horses", a handscroll by ren renfa (1255-1327) in the collection of nelson-atkins museum of art. despite the mistaken claim that the print was the reproduction of a work by another yuan horse painting specialist zhao yong (1289-1362), it seems plausible that the v&a scroll is the original on which the print was based. both nelson-atkins and the v&a's scrolls found their way to japan before entering the western collections. indeed the print is almost identical. literature: laurence binyon, the george eumorfopoulos collections: catalogue of chinese, corean and siamese paintings, london 1928, pl. neverthelsss, the painting itself is interesting because it not only links to the nelson-atkins' scroll, it is also closely related to a wood-block print in master gu's picture album (1603). compared with the fine craftsmanship of the nelson-atkins' piece, the painter of the v&a scroll is discernably less successful. in japan, nelson-atkins' scroll was so admired by the kano school painters that three members made a precise copy, one section each. these copies are now in the tokyo national museum's collection. spuriously signed as by ren renfa on the left, it is also clear that the scroll was used to deceive at some point in its history.
描述_ZN: 1794) the second section; and yamamoto ikyu, the third. 30; wai-kam ho et al, eight dynasties of chinese painting: the collections of the nelson-atkins museum, kansas city, and the cleveland museum of art, cleveland 1980, pl. 95; craig clunas, art in china, oxford 1997, fig. 98. kin juro copied the opening; hashimoto eiki (d. 被著名的英国诗人、戏剧家和艺术史家劳伦斯-宾阳描述为前尤莫福普洛斯收藏中最好的中国画例子之一，这幅引人入胜的画是《九马图》最后部分的反向图像，构图上略有不同，《九马图》是任仁发（1255-1327）的手卷，收藏于纳尔逊-阿特金斯艺术博物馆。 尽管有人错误地声称这幅画是另一位元代马画专家赵雍（1289-1362）的作品的复制品，但V&a卷是这幅画所依据的原作，似乎是可信的。 年，尼尔森-阿特金斯和V&A的画卷在进入西方收藏之前都被送到了日本。 事实上，这幅画几乎是相同的。 文献：Laurence Binyon, the george eumorfopoulos collections: catalogue of chinese, corean and siamese paintings, london 1928, pl. 无论如何，这幅画本身很有趣，因为它不仅与尼尔森-阿特金斯的画卷有关，还与顾恺之大师画册（1603年）中的木版画密切相关。 与尼尔森-阿特金斯的作品的精细工艺相比，《九马》手卷的画家明显不那么成功。 在日本，尼尔森-阿特金斯的卷轴被狩野画派的画家们所推崇，三个成员都做了一个精确的拷贝，每人一个部分。 这些副本现在都在东京国立博物馆的收藏中。 左边的签名是任仁发的，很明显，这个卷轴在历史上的某个阶段是被用来欺骗的。
